verdict.rationale: Ramp's Bill Pay evidence shows invoice OCR capture (99% accuracy), 2/3-way matching, and rules-based approval routing (ramp-docs-16, ramp-docs-17, ramp-docs-23), plus 'complete it with Ramp payments' in NetSuite/Xero integrations (ramp-docs-27, ramp-docs-28) confirming payment execution within the platform. However, none of the evidence explicitly states support for ACH, check, or wire as distinct payment rails for vendor payments. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of ACH/check/wire payment method options, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the full AP workflow.
